name: v2.0.1
body:
## What's Changed
* Fix publishing flutter packages by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4091
* Fix decoder positions of generated tokens in Canary greedy search by @ANDROIDHASSAN in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4097
* Add VoxLock target-speaker voice isolation to the speech denoisers by @arbazsiddiqui in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4085
* Adds a CLAUDE.md with build, test, lint and high-level architecture guidance for Claude Code. by @manickavela29 in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4099
* Upload VoxLock models and test data by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4101
* Add Python API for VoxLock by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4102
* Use librosa-style fbank for streaming NeMo CTC models by @ANDROIDHASSAN in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4092
* Add OfflineRecognizer.createAsync() to the Dart API by @Cassian433 in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4070
* Keep the STFT convs of Kokoro in float32 when quantizing to int8 by @Trinorae in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4087
* Add C/CXX API for VoxLock by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4104
* Add JavaScript (node-addon) API for VoxLock by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4105
* Add JavaScript (WebAssembly) API for VoxLock by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4106
* Add Java and Kotlin API for VoxLock by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4107
* Add C# API for VoxLock by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4108
* Fix CI failures by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4113
* Add Swift API for VoxLock by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4109
* Add Go API for VoxLock by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4110
* Add Dart API for VoxLock by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4111
* Add Rust API for VoxLock by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4112
* Add Pascal API for VoxLock by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4114
* Release v2.0.1 by @csukuangfj in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4115

## New Contributors
* @arbazsiddiqui made their first contribution in https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/pull/4085

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/compare/v2.0.0...v2.0.1
